correctness.rationale: With one root reservoir at injection p=1−q and removal q, the reversible stationary measure is Bernoulli product and empty mass q^N. Renewal cycle empty Exp(p) followed by root-one-particle excursion gives exact E[B]=(q^{-N}−1)/p. At q=0 full occupancy is the sole nonempty recurrent configuration; the killed finite generator has isolated zero eigenvalue and all other modes have a uniform spectral gap for fixed G. First-order right-eigenvector perturbation solves a killed one-particle occupation Poisson equation: at entrance a, h_q(a)=1−qT_G+O(q²) with T_G=[(D_o−L_G)^−1]_{oo}. Exact reversible boundary-flux identity then yields λ_q=p q^N (1−qT_G+O(q²)), and spectral separation gives q^N B ⇒ Exp(1) with all positive moments. Independent Markov generator code, different from package code, solved killed first passage means and eigenvalues on path P3 (endpoint/root center) and star S4 for q=.035,.07; mean exact to numerical tolerance, scaled eigenvalue matches first correction to O(q²). Independently computed T_P3=5/3, T_P3-center=1, T_S4-center=2/3. The result is fixed graph only; no uniform-in-N claim.
